title: 🌿✨ Reflecting on Redemption: A Blessed Day at Weegols Garden ✨🌿
paragraphs: 🌿✨ Reflecting on Redemption: A Blessed Day at Weegols Garden ✨🌿

Gratitude fills my heart today as I look back on a truly special Bible study session at Weegols Garden with the incredible staff and employees. Our time together was a powerful reminder of the love and sacrifice of Jesus Christ, and I'm immensely thankful for the support of two remarkable individuals: Jeremiah Calo and Dr. Edward Chan.
In the midst of the picturesque beauty of Weegols Garden, we delved into the profound topic of how Jesus Christ paid for our sins and reconciled us with our Heavenly Father.

Together, we explored the Garden of Gethsemane, where Jesus agonized in prayer before His crucifixion, and we marveled at the depth of His love and sacrifice for us. It's a message that reminds us of our worthiness in the eyes of our Father, not because of our deeds but because of the grace of our Savior.

I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to my cousin Jeremiah Calo for his unwavering support and for graciously allowing us to use the venue and his dedicated employees to be part of this Kingdom Assignment. Your generosity and kindness have made this gathering possible, and I'm deeply grateful.

To my Bro. Mayor Dr. Edward Chan, your understanding and support have been a source of strength throughout this journey. May God bless you both abundantly as you continue to extend your helping hands to others and make a positive impact in the lives of many.

As we part ways today, I offer a prayer for God to continue showering Jeremiah Calo and Edward Chan with abundant blessings, and may they be vessels of His love, hope, and transformation to those they encounter.
